preconditions.description: The sizes of the two sequences s and t are between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(x) <= 10 for x in s) and all(1 <= len(x) <= 10 for x in t)
preconditions.description: Each string in s and t has length between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) and x.islower() for x in s) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x.islower() for x in t)
preconditions.description: All strings in s and t consist of lowercase letters only.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 2020 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y <= 10**9 for y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query year y is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string.
Each output line is a non-empty concatenation of two strings from s and t.

postconditions.expression: all(line == s[(y-1) % n] + t[(y-1) % m] for y, line in zip(queries, output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each query year y, the output line is the concatenation of s[(y-1) % n] and t[(y-1) % m].
